name: experience-layer-phase-1b-finding-enums
title: Experience Layer Phase 1b: structured finding outcome enums + signatureTag capture + signature-registry (additive, audit-only, excluded from gates, back-compatible)
description: Implement Phase 1b from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: add optional audit-only outcome fields to findings (finding_add signatureTag; finding_resolve resolutionType+resolveEvidenceStrength; finding_dismiss dismissReasonType(optional)+dismissEvidenceStrength), a signature-registry under .lattice/learning to prevent synonym-tag drift (auto-propose on capture, active needs human approval, aliases/mergedInto), and a minimal signature CLI. All fields are additive, optional, audit-only and MUST NOT be read by advisory.ts or any gate logic, and stay out of the finding signature domain. Back-compat: legacy findings/calls omitting the fields behave unchanged. Proven by a smoke covering capture, enum validation, gate-exclusion, registry propose/approve, migration tolerance, and signal enrichment.
